summary: Lightning struck near the summit of Quandary Peak before 9 a.m., frightening two hikers badly enough that they called 911; Summit County Rescue Group paged a small team that located the pair out of an abundance of caution, while other hikers helped them below treeline. No injuries.
notes: Borderline-parked item resolved run 854 — dated 2023-06-30 (Friday) per the SCRG-spokesperson piece; SCRG small team stood up, most members quickly stood down.
